title: Shiploom locked acceptance criterion
description: Validates one acceptance object in acceptance/*.json (MASTER_SPEC 11.2). Files may contain a single object or an array of these objects; validate.py accepts both. Vagueness (unmeasurable statements) is enforced by `validate --strict`, not by this schema.

statement.description: Measurable requirement statement. Must pair with howToVerify.

oracleRef.description: Relative path under .shiploom/.oracle/, e.g. oracle/ACC-001.sh. Never an absolute path; never fed to builder context.
